name: Chicken, Mushroom & Green Pea Skillet with Quinoa

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, combine the quinoa, water, and salt; bring to a boil.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup quinoa
8 fl oz (1 cup) water
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the water comes to a boil, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lb white mushrooms
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, reduce the heat to a simmer and cover; cook for 15 minutes. Once cooked, remove from heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside.
Slice the mushrooms and transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince the shallot; add to the mushrooms.
Measure out the green peas and transfer to a bowl.
Pat dry the chicken; holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Season the chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
Place the chicken in the skillet and cook until browned, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Once the chicken has been transferred, add the shallot and mushrooms to the skillet. Season with salt and black pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, until the mushrooms have softened, 3 to 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add the broth and vinegar to the skillet; let the liquid simmer for 1 to 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
1 tbsp white wine vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Place the chicken back in the skillet and cook until it is cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the peas and half of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing) to the skillet; stir until well combined.
Uncover the quinoa and fluff with a fork.
Divide the quinoa between two plates (or one plate and one lunch container) and top each with the chicken and vegetables. Sprinkle with the remaining parsley. Enjoy!
